chunks: And We had sent admonishers to them.
ai.seo_question: Who did God send to warn the nations mentioned in Surah As-Saffat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *Tawatur* (mass transmission) of prophetic missions, affirming that no nation was left without a clear *Hujjah* (proof) from God. It reflects the divine attribute of *Rahmah* (mercy), ensuring that accountability is just because guidance was universally accessible before the advent of punishment.
